_readme: Single source of truth for UI copy in both front ends (TUI and GUI).
The active locale comes from config.language ('en' | 'zh'), read over RPC.
slash: per command id. 'en' is optional -- when absent the client falls
back to the name/help written in code, which stays the English source.
ui: both locales are required; these surfaces have no in-code source.
GUI inlines this file at build time (ui-gui/build.py).
